title: VCS Downloader Workflow

steps: Validate package has sourceReference — throw InvalidArgumentException if missing
Loop: shift next URL from list
[Git] If URL is local path → resolve immediately (skip cache)
[Git] If git ≥ 2.3 AND cache usable → fetchRefOrSyncMirror(url, cachePath, ref) to local VCS cache
[Git] Else if no git found → throw RuntimeException
On exception: log error via IO; if more URLs remain → try next URL
On last URL failure → rethrow exception
Validate package has sourceReference — throw InvalidArgumentException if missing
[Git] If cached ref available → clone from local cache with --dissociate --reference flags
[Git] Else → clone from remote URL (git clone --no-checkout, remote add composer, fetch)
[Git] updateToCommit(package, path, ref, prettyVersion) → checkout target ref
[Git] If newRef returned → update package source/dist references
On exception → try next URL or rethrow
[Git] Check hasMetadataRepository(path) → if .git missing throw RuntimeException
[Git] If cached ref available → set remoteUrl=cachePath; else remoteUrl=remote
[Git] git rev-parse to check if ref already local
[Git] If ref not local → git remote set-url + git fetch composer + fetch --tags
On exception → log, try next URL
If no exception AND io.isVerbose AND hasMetadataRepository(path):
If empty → getCommitLogs(target.ref, initial.ref, path) [rollback direction]
Format and print commit logs to io
If all URLs exhausted and exception → rethrow
On promise resolve: if result is false → throw RuntimeException('Could not delete path')
If type=update → cleanChanges(prevPackage, path, true); mark hasCleanedChanges[uniqueName]=true
cleanChanges: if getLocalChanges(package,path) not null → throw RuntimeException (uncommitted changes)

activity_flows.flow: cleanup() — called after install/update/uninstall regardless of success

key_conditions: package.getSourceReference() == null → throw (both download and install entry points)
URL list exhaustion with exception → rethrow last exception
e instanceof PHPUnit\Exception → always rethrow (test safety guard)
io.isDebug() → verbose error logging per failed URL
Filesystem.isLocalPath(url) → skip cache in doDownload; normalize realpath in prepareUrls
gitVersion >= 2.3 AND Cache.isUsable(cachePath) → use local VCS mirror cache
cachedPackages[id][ref] exists → clone/checkout from local cache (faster, offline-capable)
COMPOSER_DISABLE_NETWORK env set → throw if ref not in cache
io.isVerbose() → print commit log summary after update
logs empty after forward direction → try reverse (rollback) direction for logs
key_relationships: VcsDownloader is abstract — implements DownloaderInterface, ChangeReportInterface, VcsCapableDownloaderInterface
GitDownloader extends VcsDownloader — implements doDownload, doInstall, doUpdate, getCommitLogs, hasMetadataRepository
VcsDownloader composes ProcessExecutor (injected or created in constructor)
VcsDownloader composes Filesystem (injected or created in constructor)
VcsDownloader depends_on PackageInterface for source URLs and references
GitDownloader uses GitUtil for git-specific operations (cleanEnv, runCommands, fetchRefOrSyncMirror)
ProcessExecutor.execute() wraps Symfony Process — synchronous execution
ProcessExecutor.executeAsync() queues jobs — max 10 concurrent (configurable via COMPOSER_MAX_PARALLEL_PROCESSES)
process_executor_key_details: execute(command, &output, cwd): int — synchronous, returns exit code
executeAsync(command, cwd): PromiseInterface<Process> — queued async execution
doExecute() checks if git command needs GIT_DIR env (bare repos)
runProcess() registers SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP handler; uses Symfony Process
Max concurrent async jobs: 10 (or env COMPOSER_MAX_PARALLEL_PROCESSES)
wait(index): spins with usleep(1000) until countActiveJobs == 0
important_notes: VcsDownloader is the abstract base for Git/SVN/Mercurial downloaders. The workflow has three distinct phases: prepare (clean local changes), download+install/update (VCS operations with URL fallback loop), cleanup (reapply stashed changes). React\Promise is used throughout for async compatibility, but most operations resolve immediately. The URL retry loop is a key resilience pattern — multiple source URLs are tried in order on failure.
